 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is filed by the petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 to quash charge-sheet and the proceeding in C.C.No.18497/2022 on the file of II Additional Civil Judge &
JMFC at Kalaburagi, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 read with Section 149 of IPC.
02.

II Additional Civil Judge &
JMFC at Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The summary of the charge-sheet is that, the de-facto complainant is the legally wedded wife of the accused No.1, and their marriage was solemnized 07 years prior to the date of lodging of the FIR.
The accused Nos.2 and 3 are parents-in-law and accused Nos.4 and 5 are the sister-in-law.
They have subjected the de-facto - complainant to cruelty both physically and mentally.

On 02.09.2022 at about 10.00 p.m., the accused No.1 after consuming alcohol came to the matrimonial home and abused the de-facto - complainant in filthy language and at the instigation of accused Nos.2 and 3 threatened that he would kill the de-facto - complainant and her parents by abusing her in filthy language on phone.
03. The cognizance taken by the learned Magistrate for the aforesaid offences, is impugned in this petition by accused Nos.2 to 5.
04. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State.
05. The respondent No.2 - de-facto - complainant, though served with notice, has not chosen to appear before the Court in person or through her advocate.
06. On perusal of the FIR and the charge-sheet materials disclose that the specific allegation of abusing and threatening is against the accused No.1.

Except omnibus and general allegations, there is no specific allegation as against these petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5, as to how and in what manner they have subjected the respondent No.2 - de-facto - complainant to cruelty.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599, at Para No.18 held as under:-
"18.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar vs. State of Bihar reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The above-mentioned decisions clearly demonstrate that this court has at numerous instances expressed concern over the misuse of section 498A IPC and the increased tendency of implicating relatives of the husband in matrimonial disputes,
without analysing the long term ramifications of a trial on the complainant as well as the accused.

It is further manifest from the said judgments that false implication by way of general omnibus allegations made in the course of matrimonial dispute, if left unchecked would result in misuse of the process of law.

Therefore, this court by way Japusing S/O M Shivamurthy And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 1 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86152416/
3 of its judgments has warned the courts from proceeding against the relatives and in-laws of the husband when no prima facie case is made out against them."

sentences.text: 07. In view of the preceding analysis, I am of the view that the FIR was lodged as against these petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 with an ulterior motive to wreak vengeance and revengeful intent.
Hence, the continuation of criminal proceedings against these petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following;
 ORDER  I.
The Criminal Petition is allowed.
II. The impugned proceedings in  C.C.No.18497/2022 on the file of the Ii Additional Civil Judge and JMFC at Kalaburagi, insofar as it relates to accused Nos.2 to 5, is hereby quashed.
In view disposal of main petition, the pending I.As. if any do not survive for consideration and hence, they are disposed of.

Sd/-
